# LamaLama

> LamaLama is a free, open-source (MIT) video editor that runs in the browser and turns a plain screen recording into a polished product video. You record or upload your app, an AI finds the key moments and directs a first cut (camera moves on a 3D stage, text, motion graphics), you polish it in a real editor, then export an MP4 in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5 or share a public link.

Who it's for: founders, indie hackers, product and marketing teams who need launch videos, feature announcements, walkthroughs and social clips without an editor, an agency or desktop software.

Key facts:

- Price: free. AI features use the workspace's own Anthropic API key (bring your own key), stored encrypted at rest; every manual tool works without one.
- Runs in the browser: recording, editing and preview. Exports render on the server as MP4.
- Clips: up to 10 minutes and 1 GB each.
- Teams: shared workspaces with Owner, Admin, Editor and Viewer roles, or custom per-member permissions.
- Sign in with Google, GitHub or an email magic link.
- Self-hostable: Next.js, PostgreSQL, any S3-compatible bucket and a background worker. Rendering uses Remotion, which has its own licence (free for individuals and companies of up to 3 people).
- Created and maintained by Andrea D'Ambrosio (https://github.com/andrebuilds).

## Product

- [Home page](https://lamalama.video/): what LamaLama does
- [Create a free account](https://lamalama.video/sign-up): start making videos
- [Sign in](https://lamalama.video/sign-in)

## Features

- Brand kits: colours, fonts and logo, drafted automatically from a website
- Footage: in-browser screen recording or uploads; analysis finds the key moments
- Motion studio: camera moves, cuts, speed, transitions, text, motion graphics, layouts, lens looks, an AI director and a full-screen preview
- Videos: clips joined in order with transitions, with versioned saves
- Export and share: MP4 in every aspect ratio, or a revocable public share link
